findings.value: A council community hub just off Bethnal Green Road, with two large halls, smaller rooms and a kitchen, bookable for community activities, social clubs, parties and celebrations.

evidence.quote: Set just off Bethnal Green Road, Granby Community Hub is perfect for a range of activities
Two large halls separated by a room divider
The versatile spaces hold events such as community activities, social clubs, youth groups, parties and celebrations.

findings.value: The council says the hub's spaces are available to local community groups, resident associations and local residents.

evidence.quote: The space is available to host local community groups

notes: The council's hub page is the only source read; the lead's council event page gives no full postcode, so the facts researcher needs one (the event page cuts it at 'E2 6D'). One WebSearch found no press. The hub is not a music venue on any source read.
